history.summary: Shiva shrine at Ketakibari, Tezpur - CSV town AND district (Nagaon) are WRONG; correct town is Tezpur, district Sonitpur. Reputed to house one of the largest Shivalingas in the world. The site has two parts: the present linga and its original base a few metres away; legend says a severe earthquake uprooted the linga from its base. Built date is disputed across sources (9th-century and 12th-century claims both appear, each weakly sourced - verify). Managed by a local committee; a full shelter now protects the shrine.

name: Ketakeshwar Dewal
town_description: Tezpur is a historic city on the north bank of the Brahmaputra in Sonitpur district, Assam, often called the cultural capital of Assam. Linked to the legend of King Bana, it is a gateway to Nameri National Park and Arunachal Pradesh.

visitor_information.best_time: October-March; Maha Shivaratri draws large crowds
visitor_information.opening_hours: 6:00 AM-12:00 PM and 3:00 PM-8:00 PM per travel guides (verify locally)
